newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia has budget surplus of 7.77 mln lats.
newsitem.headline: Latvia has budget surplus of 7.77 mln lats.

text.p: Latvia is currently running a budget surplus of 7.77 million lats, made up of spending of 76.49 million lats and revenues of a total 84.26 million lats, the finance ministry said on Friday.
The figures are the latest available data on state finances and run up to February 27, the ministry said in a statement.
Latvian is planning a deficit-free budget this year after a 40 million lat funding gap in 1996.
The ministry also said that total internal state debt came to 190.54 million lats, made up mostly of government T-bills at 123.72 million lats.
